**Awacino** makes your Unraid server an unattended device: reach it, its terminal and its network from the Awacino app on your phone or computer, with no port forwarding and no router settings.
This repository holds the Awacino Unraid template. Install it, paste the setup code from the Awacino app (Add unattended device → Install on NAS) and click Apply.
Support: https://www.awacino.com/support/contact/
